hero.title: Book a photographer, and know the price before you do.
hero.body: Pick a service and a package, choose a time that is actually free, and hold it with a booking fee. The rest is paid on the day.
hero.aside: You see the full price, and what is due now, before you pay anything.

step1.title: Choose a service
step1.body: Each service has packages, and add-ons you can take or leave. Every price is listed.

step2.title: Pick a time
step2.body: You only see times that are free. Picking one holds it while you pay.

step3.title: Pay the booking fee
step3.body: A share of the total, paid by Mobile Money, confirms the booking. The rest is due on the day.

step4.title: Get your link
step4.body: We email you a private link to your booking. It is where you check the details, pay the balance and find your photos.

price.title: The price is the price
price.body: The total, the amount due now and the amount due later are all shown before you pay. Nothing is added afterwards.

hold.title: Your time is held
hold.body: The slot is taken off the calendar while your payment goes through, so nobody books it out from under you.

fee.title: The booking fee is not refunded
fee.body: If you cancel, the booking fee stays with the photographer and the time is released. We say so here, and again before you pay.

link.title: One private link, yours
link.body: Your booking lives on a link only you are emailed. You can check it, pay the balance or cancel from there.

policy.title: Cancellation terms, up front
policy.body: Each photographer sets whether the booking fee is refunded if you cancel, and until when you can. You see their terms before you book, and again before you pay.

booked.title: Find your booking any time.
booked.body: Lost the email? Enter the address you booked with and we will send you a fresh link to your booking page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: The values the whole platform runs on. The hold applies from the next booking, the trial from the next approval and the prices from the next payment; the grace and reminder days apply to every subscription at once.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the settings. Check your connection and try again.

hints.holdMinutes: How long a booking keeps its time while the client pays the booking fee. 1 to 60.
hints.trialDays: The free trial a photographer starts with on approval. 1 to 366; applies to later approvals.
hints.subscriptionMonthlyPriceRwf: Whole RWF, at least 1. A payment already started keeps its amount.
hints.subscriptionYearlyPriceRwf: Whole RWF, at least 1. A payment already started keeps its amount.
hints.subscriptionGraceDays: Days a lapsed photographer stays listed, but not bookable, before the profile is hidden. 0 to 366.
hints.subscriptionReminderDays: Up to 10 different numbers from 1 to 366, separated by commas, such as 7, 3, 1. Leave it empty to send no reminders.

invalid.holdMinutes: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 60.
invalid.trialDays: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 366.

invalid.subscriptionGraceDays: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 366.
invalid.subscriptionReminderDays: Enter at most 10 different whole numbers from 1 to 366, separated by commas.
